posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Assistance with playing a game is done through the developer. If modifications are needed, this request should be made to the developer.
The primary intent of this forum is to develop your own game. While modding is popular and at times highly supported by the game author, without a knowledge that the project is truly open and that accessing the project files will not violate a ToS, typically this forum will not accommodate such requests.
The "forbidden-ness" will depend not only on the authorship of the game project and their requirements, but also the authorship of the assets and their requirements.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
@outbalancing356
this is not a private fansite following civil laws, but the official, corporate-owned website of the company selling the editors - and is bound to corporate laws as a result.
as such the company can be sued for damages if they help anyone breaking copyright protections on any game.
if anyone were to help you here without you showing and proving that the original owner of said game gave you licence to change its game, then the owner of this site could be sued - that is the law.
it doesn't matter what you personally think about copyright laws, because it will only matter what the lawyers suing and the judge think about them.
